settings.heading: How ready is your workplace,
settings.heading_bold: and what could stronger capability be worth?
settings.desc: Answer six readiness questions about your current program, then enter your organisation's own costs to see a transparent comparison. No hidden rates — just the numbers you provide and an open formula.
settings.disclaimer: This self-assessment is general information only. Results are indicative, depend entirely on the figures entered, and do not guarantee financial, safety, legal or compliance outcomes. Confirm program scope, applicable laws, standards and costs with qualified advisers and an Andatech compliance specialist.

settings.heading: What's the ROI calculator based on?
settings.text: It uses only the figures you enter: annual test volume, outsourced test and call-out costs, the share you expect to bring in-house, one-off setup costs and ongoing annual costs. It compares potentially avoided outsourced costs with the program costs and shows the formula, so the result is transparent and indicative rather than a quoted saving.

settings.heading: What do the readiness questions tell me?
settings.text: They highlight capability gaps across six areas: policy, training, procedures, equipment, privacy and records. Each gap includes a practical next step so you can prioritise where to start, regardless of whether you proceed with a managed program.

settings.heading: Now choose how you want to partner.
settings.description: Compare purchase, lease or fully managed — then start a program conversation with our team.
